story.title: Help Ever, Hurt Never
paragraphs_en: One day, a boy went to sea. He started catching fishes. Suddenly rain started pouring heavily. A little dog fell into the sea.
The boy wanted to save him. So he took his umbrella and went into the sea. He used his umbrella like a boat.
The boy saved the dog using his umbrella. Both of them saw many beautiful fishes swimming in the sea.
The boy and the dog enjoyed sailing in the sea and saw a beautiful colorful rainbow.
The boy caught many fishes and put them into the basket for the dog to eat.
Finally, the boy took the dog and went home.
